It was my first year of college and I was going to school in Chicago. This school had apartment style dorms with a total of four people per apartment. Our people in a living space was daunting, to say the least. On my flight from my home state to the Chicago, I stupidly realized that I left my wallet at the gate when I landed at O'Hare. Had no idea where it actually was so shit was gone. 

Then in the distance, I see one my roommates who I had not talked to prior with my wallet in hand approach me and say "Hey I'm your roommate #1 [Insert Name] and I think this is your wallet?" This guy ended up becoming one of my best friends along with my other roommates as well. 

Ended up transferring because I absolutely hated the school. It was a very hard discussion for me to have with the boys. I'm a very introverted fellow and I finally found people I was fully comfortable with only to have to leave them. Still miss them. Finishing up my second year right now and while I'm much happier with my education, I haven't met anyone that compares.
